Name: Cloudcutter
Author: duijiangyaoyue
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b]Cloudcutter[/b] is a bamboo-cored sword that grows with every monster you kill.
It arrives on the first day in a handwritten letter, starts modest at 10–15 damage, and sharpens along a smooth curve until it outclasses the strongest blade in your game. At 250 kills it learns to drink; at 500 it learns to cut the clouds; at 1000 it is complete.
Balanced against vanilla by default (1.5× the Infinity Blade), and it automatically upgrades itself to SVE or Ridgeside Village tiers when those mods are installed. No vanilla weapon is touched, so it plays nicely with any weapon pack.
[b]裁云 [/b]是一把随杀怪数成长的竹骨长刃。
第一日，一封古风手书随信送到农舍邮箱。初到手时它只有 10–15 伤害，并不起眼；但你握着它斩落的每一头怪物，都会让刃上多一分锋芒。
二百斩，刃生嗜血之性；五百斩，可引云气为刃；千斩之后，裁云大成，云开见日。
默认按原版最强剑（Infinity Blade 80–100）的 1.5 倍平衡，终阶 120–150；装了 SVE 或 Ridgeside Village 会自动升到对应档位（120–180 / 300–375）。不修改任何原版或其它模组的武器，可与武器扩展类模组共存
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1.Install SMAPI 4.0+ for Stardew Valley 1.6.
2.(Optional but recommended) Install Generic Mod Config Menu to change settings in-game.
3.Download this mod and unzip it.
4.Place the Cloudcutter folder into Stardew Valley/Mods/.
5.Launch the game through SMAPI, load a save, and check the mailbox on your farm.
6.No new save is required — the mod can be added to an existing save at any time.[/color]
1.安装 SMAPI 4.0+（对应星露谷物语 1.6）。
2.（可选，推荐） 安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，方便在游戏内改设置。
3.下载并解压本模组。
4.把 Cloudcutter 文件夹整个放进 Stardew Valley/Mods/。
5.通过 SMAPI 启动游戏，读取存档，查看农舍邮箱。
6.不需要新开存档，现有存档随时可以加入
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]A sword that levels with you.[/b] Damage grows from 10–15 to 120–150 by default, driven by the monsters you kill while holding it — not by a fixed recipe.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Smooth 1.25-power growth curve.[/b] Restrained for the first hundred kills, noticeably faster after 500, landing exactly on the final tier at 1000. No flat +2-per-tier grind.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Day-one gift letter.[/b] A short classical-style letter arrives in your mailbox on the first day; read it and click the sword icon to claim the blade.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Milestones that change how it plays.[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]250 kills — Vampiric enchantment[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]500 kills — Cloud Slash: press V[/color][color=#D4D4D8] for a 3.5-tile area strike (15 energy, 2.5 s cooldown)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]1000 kills — Cloud Slash mastered: 5-tile radius, ×1.3 damage, 30% shorter cooldown[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Live progress in the tooltip.[/b] Hover the sword to see tier, kills and current damage, plus a rank that advances from Dormant → Keen → Attuned → Perfected.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Balance that respects your mod list.[/b] Vanilla 1.5× by default; automatically scales to 120–180 with SVE or 300–375 with Ridgeside Village. Auto-scaling is on by default and can be overridden with custom final values.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]16 settings in GMCM[/b], including growth, balance, unlock thresholds, the Cloud Slash keybind, energy cost and cooldown. A bundled [/color]

[code]config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8] covers players without GMCM.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Save-safe.[/b] Kill count is stored on the weapon itself, so it survives chests and travels between saves. Older Qingfeng/Frostedge swords are migrated automatically with their kill counts.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Compatible by design.[/b] Only adds its own [/color]

[code]Data/Weapons[/code][color=#D4D4D8] entry; vanilla, SVE and RSV weapons are untouched.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Multiplayer aware.[/b] Only kills made by a local player holding the sword are counted.[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]随杀怪成长的剑。[/b] 默认从 10–15 伤害长到 120–150；只有[b]手持裁云[/b]时击杀的怪物才计数，换别的武器打不会成长。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]1.25 次幂成长曲线。[/b] 前 100 杀涨得克制，500 杀后明显提速，1000 杀正好落在终阶目标，不是每阶固定 +2 的枯燥数值。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]第一日赠剑信。[/b] 一封古风手书投进邮箱，读信后点一下信里的剑图标才会收进背包。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]会改变玩法的阶段解锁。[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]250 杀 — 「吸血」附魔[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]500 杀 — 「裁云斩」：按 V [/color][color=#D4D4D8]以自身为中心 3.5 格范围伤害（15 体力，2.5 秒冷却）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]1000 杀 — 「裁云大成」：范围扩至 5 格、伤害 ×1.3、冷却缩短三成[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]悬停即可看到进度。[/b] 阶数、击杀数、当前伤害，以及随进度变化的称号：初醒 → 凌厉 → 通灵 → 圆满。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]按你的模组表平衡。[/b] 默认原版 1.5 倍；自动缩放默认开启，装 SVE 用 120–180，装 RSV 用 300–375；也可关闭自动缩放，手动指定终阶伤害。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]GMCM 内 16 项设置[/b]：成长、平衡、解锁阈值、裁云斩按键（可直接改绑）、体力消耗与冷却。没装 GMCM 也有随包的 [/color]

[code]config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8]。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]存档安全。[/b] 击杀数记在武器自身，放进箱子、带去别的存档都不会丢；旧版「清风剑」「霜刃」会自动迁移，击杀数保留。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]兼容性优先。[/b] 只往 [/color]

[code]Data/Weapons[/code][color=#D4D4D8] 添加自己的条目，原版、SVE、RSV 的武器一概不动。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]联机可用。[/b] 只统计本地玩家手持裁云时造成的击杀。[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] (built and tested on 1.6.15; other 1.6.x versions should work)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Optional:[/i] [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — for the in-game settings page[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Optional:[/i] [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] and/or [b]Ridgeside Village[/b] — install them as usual (they require Content Patcher); Cloudcutter detects them and adjusts its final tier[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]No other dependencies. Works on existing saves; removing it later leaves the blade as a harmless "error item" until reinstalled.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]星露谷物语 1.6.15（在 1.6.15 上编译与测试；其他 1.6.x 版本理论可用，但未逐一验证）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0 或更高版本[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]可选： Generic Mod Config Menu — 游戏内设置页面[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]可选： Stardew Valley Expanded 和/或 Ridgeside Village — 按正常方式安装即可（它们依赖 Content Patcher）；裁云会自动识别并调整终阶[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]没有其它依赖。可加入现有存档；卸载后存档里的剑会变成原版「错误物品」兜底，装回即恢复。[/color][/*]
[/list]
